name: kaeru-core
description: The shared foundation for the self-hosted Kaeru Platform.

scripts.db:test:create: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U kaeru -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE kaeru_test' 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:test:create && cd backend && KAERU_TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://kaeru:kaeru_dev@localhost:5432/kaeru_test?sslmode=disable" go test ./internal/database/ -count=1
